charter.office: Economic Enterprise Management Division, Legazpi Public Market

personnel.name: Mr. Ronald H. Pasano
personnel.position: Local Operations Officer IV, Legazpi Market Administrator

personnelNotes: The Economic Enterprise Management Division is published under the City Mayor's Office and issues a separate charter for each market it runs. This one covers the Legazpi Public Market. It names only the Market Administrator; its process tables identify everyone else by role.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Submit a written complaint to the Public Market Office, or use the hotline or email.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: A complaint is acknowledged within three working days and acted on accordingly.

services.title: Applying for a new stall lease
services.description: Applying for a stall at the Legazpi Public Market if you do not already hold one. The application goes to the Market Committee, and where more than one person applies for the same stall it is decided by raffle. At roughly twenty-one working days this is much the longest service the market publishes.
services.office: Legazpi City Public Market Office / Economic Enterprise Management Division
services.whoMayAvail: Qualified applicants with no existing lease

requirements.item: Letter of intent, or an accomplished application form

steps.client: Submit the application and the requirements.
steps.agency: Receives and records the application.

steps.client: The application is endorsed for review.
steps.agency: Conducts an initial review of the documents and forwards them to the Market Committee.

steps.client: Your eligibility is screened and validated.
steps.agency: Evaluates the applications. Where there is more than one applicant, conducts a raffle.

steps.client: The stall is approved and awarded.
steps.agency: Issues the notice of award to the raffle winner or the qualified applicant.

steps.client: Pay the lease fee and goodwill.
steps.agency: Issues the official receipt.

steps.client: Sign the contract.
steps.agency: Records and releases the contract copy.

notes: Where more than one person applies for the same stall, it is decided by raffle.
verifyNotes: The charter's own total of 21 working days and 20 minutes does not reconcile with the durations it prints, however the ranges are read. The steps recorded here come to 18 days and 35 minutes at their upper bounds, and one step reads only "within the day", which the arithmetic cannot count. Check the PDF.
The charter's client and agency columns are offset against each other on this page, so the pairing of client steps to agency actions is an inference.
The charter's person-responsible column contains a stray "Responsible3" heading artefact.

services.title: Renewing a stall lease
services.description: Renewing an existing stall lease at the Legazpi Public Market.
services.office: Legazpi City Public Market Office / Economic Enterprise Management Division
services.whoMayAvail: Existing stallholders with a valid lease contract

requirements.item: Official receipt of payment for the last rental

steps.client: Submit the requirements.
steps.agency: Verifies the documents.

steps.client: Pay the lease renewal fee.
steps.agency: Issues the official receipt.

steps.client: Sign the renewal contract.
steps.agency: Records and releases the contract copy.

verifyNotes: The charter's column order on this page puts Person Responsible before Processing Time and Fees, unlike its other services. The values are recorded in their proper fields.

services.title: Getting a market clearance
services.description: The clearance a stallholder needs for a renewal, a transfer, a termination or any other official purpose. You have to settle any unpaid obligations first.
services.whoMayAvail: Market stallholders needing a clearance for renewal, transfer, termination or other official purposes

requirements.item: Clearance of financial obligations, meaning the official receipt

steps.client: Submit your request for a market clearance.
steps.agency: Receives and reviews the documents.

steps.client: Settle any unpaid obligations.
steps.agency: Issues the statement of account and accepts payment.

steps.client: Claim the market clearance certificate.
steps.agency: Prepares and releases the clearance.

notes: What you pay depends on what you owe. The charter puts no figure on it because it is your own arrears.

services.title: Ending a stall lease
services.description: Terminating or cancelling a stall lease at the Legazpi Public Market. You settle any arrears, then surrender the stall and its keys.
services.whoMayAvail: Registered market stallholders who wish to terminate their lease

requirements.item: Formal letter of request for termination addressed to the City Market Administrator
Clearance of outstanding financial obligations, if any

steps.client: Submit the letter request and the required documents.
steps.agency: Receives and reviews the documents.

steps.client: Settle any unpaid rental or arrears.
steps.agency: Issues the statement of account and accepts payment.

steps.client: Surrender the stall and its keys.
steps.agency: Conducts the inspection and accepts the turnover.

verifyNotes: The steps read here sum to 30 minutes against the charter's stated total of 45 minutes, a gap of fifteen. Check the PDF for a missing row.

services.title: Getting a permit for a promotional sale
services.description: A permit for an accredited business or corporation to run a promotional sale in the market for a day or several days.
services.office: Legazpi City Public Market Office / Economic Enterprise Management Division
services.whoMayAvail: Accredited or registered business establishments and corporations

requirements.item: Letter of request addressed to the Market Administrator
Proposed dates of the promotional sale

steps.client: Submit the request letter with the requirements.
steps.agency: Receives and logs the application.

steps.client: Your proposed dates and compliance are reviewed.
steps.agency: Evaluates and approves or disapproves the request.

steps.client: Pay the promotional fee, if one applies.
steps.agency: Issues the official receipt.

steps.client: Receive the permit or the approval notice.
steps.agency: Records and releases the permit.

verifyNotes: The first step is a range, 5 to 10 minutes. The arithmetic reads the upper figure, which is what makes the derived total match the charter's stated 35 minutes.

services.title: Making a complaint about the market
services.description: How a vendor, a customer or anyone else raises a complaint about the Legazpi Public Market. It can end in a mediated dialogue between the parties, and you get a written response.
services.whoMayAvail: Vendors, customers or the general public with a valid complaint about the public market

requirements.item: Supporting documents or evidence, if applicable

steps.client: File the complaint verbally or in writing at the Market Office.
steps.agency: Records and acknowledges the complaint, and gives you a complaint form if you need one.

steps.client: Submit the accomplished complaint form with any evidence.
steps.agency: Reviews and evaluates the complaint.

steps.client: Attend the dialogue or mediation, if one is required.
steps.agency: Facilitates a resolution between the parties.

steps.client: Receive feedback on how the complaint was resolved.
steps.agency: Issues the written response or resolution.
